question: To which deity is the next set of eight-fragrances traditionally attributed?
premises: It is stated as remembered tradition.
inference: The eight-fragrances of Viṣṇu are remembered in tradition.
uncertainties: The specific ingredients of Viṣṇu’s gandhāṣṭaka are not listed in this verse.
plain_english: The eight-fragrances of Viṣṇu are remembered in tradition.
